biography: Felipe Matos grew up in the shadow of Interlagos, the roar of engines his lullaby. His father, a mechanic for a local touring car team, instilled a love for motorsports from a young age. Instead of toys, Felipe received miniature wrenches and spark plugs. His racing career began humbly in karting, funded by his father's tireless work. One defining moment came at the São Paulo Kart Championship when, despite starting last due to a mechanical issue, Felipe carved his way through the field to snatch victory on the final lap. Now, at 23, he's making waves in the Opala Old Stock Race, a series celebrating classic Brazilian touring cars. He's considered one of the rising stars, known for his consistent performance and remarkable car control. While he dreams of Formula racing, he’s focused on mastering the demanding art of old-school racing, proving his worth one race at a time. His dedication is unwavering, fueled by the memory of his father's sacrifices and the unwavering support of his local community.
drivingStyle: Felipe's driving style is best described as precise and calculated. He's not one for flamboyant overtakes, preferring to methodically build pace throughout a race. He excels at tire management, often coaxing extra laps out of his rubber when others are struggling with degradation. His approach to corners is smooth and controlled, prioritizing exit speed over aggressive entry. Under pressure, he remains remarkably calm, able to execute his strategy even in the most intense situations. This composed demeanor, combined with his mechanical understanding of the Opala, makes him a formidable competitor.

rivalries.reason: A fierce rivalry sparked from a controversial collision during the 2022 Interlagos race, where Vargas accused Felipe of deliberately causing the incident.
A battle for the championship lead in the 2023 season created a tense and competitive atmosphere between these two talented drivers.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, gifted to him by his grandmother, for every race.
Before each race, he spends 15 minutes meticulously cleaning his helmet visor, regardless of how clean it already is.
He listens to a specific track of Brazilian samba music to calm his nerves before getting into the car.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed; it's about understanding the machine and respecting the track. Every turn tells a story, you just have to listen."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2023 Ribeirão Preto round of the Opala Old Stock Race, a hard-fought victory where he overtook three cars in the final two laps.
careerLowPoint: Suffering a mechanical failure at the 2021 Interlagos race, which cost him a potential podium finish and valuable championship points.
